name: @awcms-one/kontrak
description: Type-only DTO contract apps/storefront needs from apps/cms, IMPORTED from its source — not hand-copied (issue #6). Import direction is one-way: storefront -> kontrak -> cms, guarded by tests/kontrak-arah-impor.test.mjs. No runtime value of any kind ships from src/** — export type only — so apps/storefront's client bundle never carries a byte of apps/cms code.
